_metadata.description: Machine-readable form of self-audit.md — personal footprint-reduction controls, searchable by the Huntsman Search Engine (HSE) alongside the detection catalog. Each control is run by the user against their OWN accounts; the framework performs no collection against people. Uses the same schema as detections.json (tier='self-audit'): 'query' = how to check, 'tuning' = the fix, 'data_source' = the self-service tool.

entries.name: Breach & credential exposure
entries.data_source: Have I Been Pwned; password manager audit
entries.summary: Which of your emails/passwords appear in public breaches; reused/weak passwords.
entries.query: haveibeenpwned.com for each email; hibp Passwords (k-anonymity) for suspect passwords; run your password manager's reuse/weak audit.
entries.tuning: Change any breached password everywhere it was reused; enable MFA; move crown-jewel accounts to passkeys/hardware keys; subscribe to HIBP alerts.

entries.name: Secrets in your own code
entries.summary: Live API keys/tokens/certs committed to your public repos or their history.
entries.query: GitHub → Settings → Code security → Secret scanning alerts; run gitleaks/trufflehog over your repos locally.
entries.tuning: Rotate the secret FIRST (revoke+reissue), then scrub history with git-filter-repo; enable push protection + a pre-commit secret hook.

entries.name: Search-engine & data-broker footprint
entries.data_source: Google 'Results about you'; people-search opt-outs; DeleteMe/Kanary
entries.summary: Public PII (address, phone, relatives) aggregated by brokers and surfaced in search.
entries.query: Search your name in quotes, name+city, name+employer; review Spokeo/WhitePages/BeenVerified/Radaris.
entries.tuning: Use Google Results-about-you removals + alerts; opt out of each broker (they re-list — recheck) or automate with DeleteMe.

entries.name: Social media exposure
entries.summary: Oversharing (org chart, tech stack, schedule, geotags) that fuels pretext/spear-phishing.
entries.query: Run each platform's privacy checkup; review old posts for PII/locations; check whether posts embed GPS.
entries.tuning: Lock down audience; hide connection lists; delete/lock old content; disable location on the camera/app; report impersonation accounts.

entries.name: Phone number & SIM-swap protection
entries.summary: SIM-swap / port-out exposure and reliance on SMS as an MFA factor.
entries.query: Ask your carrier for a port-freeze / transfer PIN; check if your number is in HIBP; inventory accounts using SMS 2FA.
entries.tuning: Enable the carrier port-freeze/PIN (#1 SIM-swap defense); move SMS 2FA to an authenticator app or passkey; set a non-default voicemail PIN.

entries.name: Email posture & inbox rules
entries.summary: Hidden auto-forwarding or inbox rules — classic account-takeover/BEC persistence (see detection C-03).
entries.query: Review auto-forward + ALL inbox rules on every mailbox; audit aliases; confirm the recovery address is secured; list app passwords.
entries.tuning: Delete any rule you didn't create; use per-service aliases to trace leaks; revoke legacy app passwords that bypass MFA.

entries.name: Account & OAuth-grant review
entries.summary: Unknown sessions/devices, and third-party OAuth apps with mail/file scope (APT29's move — see detection H-01/H-04).
entries.query: Review recent security activity, registered devices, MFA device list, and connected third-party apps on each account.
entries.tuning: Sign out unknown sessions; remove unknown devices/MFA registrations; revoke every unused OAuth grant, especially mail/file scopes.

entries.name: Financial & identity monitoring
entries.summary: Downstream fraud risk from any exposed identity data.
entries.query: Freeze credit at all bureaus; review statements for small test charges; enable issuer alerts; set a tax/gov IP-PIN where available.
entries.tuning: Keep the freeze on (thaw on demand); dispute anomalies early; enable real-time transaction alerts.

entries.name: Metadata & document leakage
entries.summary: GPS/device metadata in shared photos and author/path metadata in published documents.
entries.query: Inspect a posted photo for GPS/device EXIF; check Office/PDF properties (author, org, path); scan your resume for home address/DOB.
entries.tuning: Strip metadata before sharing; clear document properties before publishing; minimize PII on public docs (use a contact form).

entries.name: Home network & IoT
entries.data_source: Router admin console; your ISP/router tools
entries.summary: Default router creds, exposed services, and unsegmented IoT on your own perimeter.
entries.query: Log into your router (default password? firmware current?); check what your public IP exposes via your own router/ISP tools; inventory IoT.
entries.tuning: Change router creds; update firmware; disable remote admin/UPnP; put IoT on a guest VLAN; use WPA3/WPA2 with a strong passphrase.

entries.name: Browser & endpoint hygiene
entries.data_source: Browser extension/settings review; OS update settings
entries.summary: Over-permissioned extensions, browser-stored passwords, missing patches, unencrypted disk.
entries.query: Audit installed browser extensions + permissions; review browser-saved passwords; confirm auto-update on; confirm disk encryption + short auto-lock.
entries.tuning: Remove unused/over-asking extensions; migrate saved passwords to a manager; patch promptly; enable FileVault/BitLocker.

entries.name: Recovery-path hardening
entries.data_source: Account recovery settings; carrier/ISP account PINs
entries.summary: Weak recovery paths let attackers reset their way in via help-desk/vishing (Scattered Spider's specialty).
entries.query: Generate + store offline MFA backup codes; review recovery questions/emails/phones; set account-level PINs with your carrier/ISP.
entries.tuning: Use random recovery answers stored in your manager; secure the recovery email; set carrier/ISP PINs to block phone-based pretext resets.
